_: Voice narration on GitHub with Gemini TTS (.github/workflows/narration-tts.yml). Edit, commit, push: the workflow voices what is listed and commits the takes to audio/vo-takes/. `audition`: voices for audio/vo-audition.py; `takes`: named takes (voice, text, style) to try a direction or a pronunciation; `scripts`: synth-vo.py scripts to voice in `voice`. Bump `run` to re-run with no other change. `name_variants`: voice each script once per way of saying the name (say_name, name_note).

takes.name: 1-Sulafat-playful
takes.style: Playful and warm, like telling a good friend something you're a little excited about: a smile in the voice, light teasing on 'be honest', a beat of mock guilt on 'never open again', bright and proud on the name. Conversational and unhurried, with natural breaths and small pauses at commas and ellipses. Never an announcer, never salesy.
takes.text: Okay, be honest. How many things did you save this month… and never open again? That's exactly why we made Makeena.

The product name "Machina" is pronounced mah-KEE-nah: three syllables, stress on the middle one, the "ch" said as a hard "k" (as in "machine" in Latin), never "MAH-chee-nah" or "ma-SHEE-nah".
